Acquisition spend is excluded from FCF and acquired growth from revenue (treated as value-neutral; Amphenol's record of lifting acquired margins is upside not modelled).

notes.pe: PATH REVIEW 2026-11-06 (locked CLAUDE.md rule: exit P/E = own long-run forward P/E median unless a stated fact argues otherwise). Own forward P/E, verified: IBKR split-adjusted monthly closes / realised adjusted diluted EPS of the next 4 reported quarters (APH 8-K ex99.1 releases 2018-2026, post-2026-split basis): 10-year (2016-12..2026-11, n 116) median 25.2x, p25 23.6x, p75 26.9x, min 19.5x (2020-03); 5-year (n 61) median 25.6x, p25 23.8x, p75 27.1x; stable in every sub-period (2017-19 24.4x, 2020-21 25.6x, 2022-23 25.6x, 2024-26 25.3x). Base exit 20 -> 25 (the median, rounded down); the 04.11 reason for 20 was 'the 2015-19 P/E history is unverified' (now verified at 24.4x) plus a Gordon P/E of 16.3x, which is a model output, not a fact about the company; our own measured errors show a faded exit multiple biases 5-year paths low (-0.22 log). Caveat: realised (perfect-foresight) forward P/E sits BELOW the consensus forward P/E of the time in beat years (APH beat the top of its EPS guide in 17 of 17 guided quarters 2022-2026), so 25x is if anything low. Bull 26 -> 27 (own 10-year p75 26.9x). Bear 17 kept: a stated fact-based de-rating (AI digestion plus in-rack copper losing to co-packaged optics from the 2028 Feynman generation), below the own 10-year minimum of 19.5x. Today's forward P/E 20.8x on the 11-05 close (21.4x at 74.09) on NTM EPS 3.45 (Q4'26 guide 0.82 + Q1-Q3'27 from consensus 3.59) is in the bottom 5% of its own 10-year range. Peer TE Connectivity (TEL): 206.36 (IBKR 11-05 close) / FY26 adjusted EPS 11.52 = 17.9x trailing; / (Q1 FY27 guide 3.30 x 4 = 13.20) = 15.6x run-rate forward (TE 8-K ex99.1 2026-10-28).
